title: Universe export
note: Local and self-host move exports use --pause-source to stop writers and drain client sessions, bind one snapshot to the archive and receipt, and remain paused until explicit universe resume. A backup without the flag carries False and cannot enter hosted replacement. Hosted Prepare archive pauses only its source, with polled phases Checking access, Pausing source, Finishing active work, Exporting database, Packing archive, Uploading archive, and Archive ready; source paused. Phase status shows elapsed seconds and bytes. The completed signed link offers Download archive and Copy link with an absolute expiry time; Resume source restores the source explicitly. Import shows Fetching archive, Verifying archive, Checking destination, and Replacing universe before receipt status. Refusals and recovery stay in the active dialog; interrupted import responses recover the durable receipt before suggesting another attempt. Export completion is not destination acceptance. Artifact transfer uses caller-owned routing and an injectable S3 client factory for hosted credentials. Local and self-host archives upload through the destination org machine connection: universe upload streams signed multipart bytes directly to storage, renews URLs for slow transfers and prints the fresh signed source link, expiry and dashboard Import page. It refuses a connection belonging to another org. PostgreSQL admission closes the original source to every client, including older engines, while export and paused self-host authentication read a frozen copy. The copy needs additional database space and is removed after Resume. Server/import coordination stays on a maintenance-database lock. Failed Resume refences the source; any writes accepted during the explicit attempt remain. Output-folder write access is checked before pausing; an unavailable path gives universe_export_destination_unavailable without stopping writers. The completion summary names only included artifact paths.
